test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best depicts the relationship between the following classes.

Brother, Nephew, Uncle
solution:
Venn diagram according to the given information is:

**Brother, Nephew, Uncle**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8cf84e79990b66f4d53edb52fdbcdbcfce7951ae50b1d55cb8c5e91004f8306.png] 

Some brother are nephew as well as uncle.

Some Nephew are brother as well as uncle

And, Some uncle are brother as well as Nephew.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (2)".**
